newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 industry sales seen up 5.0-6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 industry sales seen up 5.0-6.0 pct.

text.p: Brazilian industry sales should grow by between 5.0 percent and 6.0 percent in real terms in 1996 compared with 1995, the private National Industry Confederation (CNI) said.
The CNI said in a statement it expected average industry capacity utilization to be 78 percent in 1996, unchanged from 1995.
The CNI also said it expected 1996 industrial employment levels to be 7.0 percent lower than in 1995.
The total amount of salaries paid should fall by between 1.0-2.0 percent while the real value of the average salary should rise by 5.0 percent, it added.
